rule: Any exception escaping decide_and_commit, and any FALLBACK_UNCERTAINTY report (returned or attached), permanently marks PRT resource state unverified in-process. Attached reports are evidence only, never bound to the current call (no per-call nonce exists). CP1 then refuses further release in that process.
rationale: Prevents stale/callback-written parent_release_* entries from hiding unresolved PRT descriptors in the global resource join. Availability-only cost, consistent with bare-journal-never-authority J1–J8 and conservative ENDED rejection 5db1f4db.
